name: Under-five mortality rate
definition: Probability of dying before the fifth birthday per 1000 live births

name: Neonatal mortality rate
definition: Deaths in the first 28 days of life per 1000 live births

name: Births attended by skilled health personnel
definition: Share of births attended by skilled health personnel

name: DTP3 immunization coverage among one-year-olds
definition: Share of one-year-olds who received the third dose of DTP-containing vaccine

name: Measles (MCV1) immunization coverage among one-year-olds
definition: Share of one-year-olds who received the first dose of measles-containing vaccine

name: Stunting prevalence in children under 5
definition: Share of children under 5 with height-for-age more than 2 SD below the reference median
